background_setting: An environment assembled from one repeating texture patch with the seams left visible, so the same cluster of detail recurs at fixed intervals across the whole frame. There is no coherent ground plane: the surface underfoot shifts height between frames and offers no consistent horizon to read against. Granular surfaces crawl and simmer rather than holding still, and their apparent grain size changes with camera distance instead of staying fixed to the geometry. Distant elements are rendered at a visibly coarser resolution than near ones, producing a hard band across the middle distance where quality drops. Vertical elements are spaced with mechanical regularity and duplicated at identical heights. Depth cues contradict each other, with atmospheric haze applied to near objects and omitted from far ones.

lighting.conditions: A single flat overhead source with no falloff, so every surface returns the same value and the image reads as one plane with no depth.
lighting.direction: Unresolvable. Highlights imply a source in one position while shadows imply another, and both wander during the shot without any change in the scene.
lighting.shadows: Contact shadows are missing entirely, so everything appears to hover just above the surface it should be resting on. The cast shadows that do exist have hard aliased edges, fall at angles that match no light source, and shimmer frame to frame even where nothing is moving.
lighting.illumination_effect: No bounce, no ambient occlusion, no gradient between lit and unlit areas. The result looks like a viewport preview with lighting disabled rather than a photographed scene.

aesthetics.patterns: Obvious texture tiling, moire across fine repeating detail, and stair-stepped aliasing along every high-contrast edge.

cinematography.lens_focal_length: Mismatched perspective, combining wide-angle stretching at the frame edges with long-lens compression through the centre of the same image.

temporal_caption: Nothing in this clip holds together across time. From the opening frames the subject and its surroundings move on unrelated clocks, so forward motion never matches the effort that should be producing it. Around the two-second mark the subject freezes while everything behind it keeps churning, and the shot then cuts abruptly to a different configuration without showing the movement in between. Through the final seconds the image degrades steadily: fine texture simmers instead of holding still, flat areas break into visible bands, edges accumulate fringing and blocking, and the subject's proportions wander far enough that it ends the clip as a different shape than it began.
physical_realism: No consistent physics anywhere in the shot. Contact is never resolved, so bodies intersect surfaces and pass through obstacles instead of being stopped by them. Loose material neither compresses under weight nor scatters on impact, and disturbed particles hang in place rather than settling. Momentum appears and disappears without cause, with instant starts, instant stops, and direction changes that require forces nothing in the scene could supply. Friction is inconsistent across identical surfaces, and anything displaced fails to return to rest in a stable position.
